entries.entry_name: Flame Breath — Horvantud the Fire Maw
entries.mitigation: Tank faces Horvantud away from the group; non-tanks stay out of the frontal flame cone.

entries.entry_name: Ground Eruptions — Horvantud the Fire Maw
entries.mitigation: Move out of fire eruptions without dragging Horvantud through the group or scattering the stack.

entries.entry_name: Dremora Waves — Horvantud the Fire Maw
entries.mitigation: Control and burn incoming Dremora before add pressure compounds with boss fire mechanics.
Tank blocks the cleave and faces the Ash Titan away from the group.
Dodge or step out of meteor impacts and avoid overlapping targeted fire on teammates.
Control and kill burning atronachs before they overlap with flame walls and meteor pressure.
Dodge targeted meteors and avoid stacking impacts on the group.
Move together to safe platforms and preserve remaining floor space as platforms are lost.
Interrupt dangerous flame casts when available and prioritize survival while the arena is collapsing.
